title: Secure Credential Management
definition: The practice of securely managing sensitive credentials to minimize security risks and enhance privacy, trust, and reputation.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Keeping your private information safe and secure.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Properly managing sensitive credentials for security and privacy.
difficulty_levels.expert: Secure credential management involves more than just security. It also encompasses privacy, trust, and reputation.

extra_fields.insight: Secure credential management enhances trust and reputation by demonstrating a commitment to protecting user data and maintaining security.
